cl_gen_deaths_how_counted.q: How is a death counted as a drug death?
cl_gen_deaths_how_counted.short: Different lists use different rules, so they do not always count the same deaths.
cl_gen_deaths_how_counted.but: The matching studies cover three places. The newest linked data are from 2012.
how: Some lists count drug poisoning as the main cause. Others count drugs found in tests, with age limits.
One death can be counted under several drugs. Finding a drug does not by itself show that it caused the death.
About 49 out of 100 people were on both lists in Norway. Fewer than half were on both in Sweden.
In New Mexico, about 89 out of 100 were on both lists. This study included other poisons too.

cl_gen_deaths_missed.q: Do official counts miss drug deaths?
cl_gen_deaths_missed.short: Some deaths are missing; others are counted without showing which drug was involved.
cl_gen_deaths_missed.but: The gaps differ by place and rules. Most evidence concerns older US opioid deaths.
how: In US records from 1999 to 2015, about 23 out of 100 overdoses had only an unspecified-drug code.
Models guessed which drugs those counted deaths involved. They did not find deaths missing from the total.
In Stockholm, lists with similar totals disagreed about which people to include. They used different rules.
An England and Wales estimate suggests counts held about two thirds of deaths involving each opioid. It did not match each death across lists.

cl_opi_deaths_heroin_missed.q: Do official counts miss heroin deaths?
cl_opi_deaths_heroin_missed.short: Closer file reviews linked more deaths to heroin than certificates or codes did.
cl_opi_deaths_heroin_missed.but: The reviews used their own rules. Their findings do not prove a worldwide missing-death rate.
how: Heroin turns into morphine in the body. Some records said morphine or mixed drugs instead of heroin.
In Maryland, certificates named heroin in about 52 out of 100 deaths the fuller protocol linked to heroin.
In Victoria, about 34 out of 100 model-selected deaths lacked the heroin code. Some were outside the national poisoning definition.
An England and Wales estimate was about half as large again as the count. It combined heroin and morphine and did not match each death.
